description: pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs: smime_policy() and code_signing_policy() do not set max_path_len. Only web_pki_policy() sets it to 2 (TLS BR §7.1.1). The CA/B Forum S/MIME BR §7.2.2 specifies max path length for S/MIME certificate hierarchies. The Code Signing BR also has path length constraints. Both functions leave max_path_len at the ValidationPolicy default of 10, which is too permissive for these profiles. This means a malicious intermediate chain of up to 10 CAs would pass smime_policy / code_signing_policy validation, where the actual BR documents restrict this to 1-2 intermediates. Reference: S/MIME BR §7.2.2 (Root CA signs Subordinate CA cert only), Code Signing BR §7.1.1.
title: smime_policy and code_signing_policy missing max_path_len
